hooks.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $sound=$env:CODEX_PERMISSION_CHIME_SOUND; if ($sound -and (Test-Path $sound)) { try { (New-Object System.Media.SoundPlayer $sound).PlaySync(); exit 0 } catch {} }; try { [System.Media.SystemSounds]::Asterisk.Play(); Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 700 } catch { [Console]::Beep(880,250) }"
